images.used_for: the ground under the whole hero, tinted by the accent plane on one side of the lean
images.note: Lightened hard and its contrast crushed on the way in (ffmpeg eq brightness=0.36 contrast=0.40 saturation=1.22). That is what lets the accent plane be a TINT at about three quarters rather than a lid: the picture gave up its brightness range so the orange could give up its opacity, and a contrast ratio is computed from luminance alone so the colour it kept costs nothing. Untouched under the same tint, dark type landed on a dark shelf line at 1.27:1. Every line on the plane is measured on all three palettes by shots/herotext.mjs, at 1440 and 390.
